newsitem.title: USA: TABLE-Adolph Coors Co Q2 oper shr rises.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Adolph Coors Co Q2 oper shr rises.

text.p: (Dollars in thousands, except per share data)
NOTE: 1997 Q2 excluding special items $36.5 million, up 35 percent from $27.0 million a year earlier. EPS excluding special items were $0.97, up 37 percent from $0.71 a year ago.

Inclusive of special items, net income was $51.0 million, more than double the $23.8 million for second quarter 1996, with EPS $1.36, versus $0.63 a year ago. Pretax earnings were $91.8 million, up from $41.0 million a year ago.
Second quarter 1997 results include a net special credit of $32.5 million pretax ($14.6 million, or $0.39 per share, after tax). This credit is made up of three elements:
* A $71.5-million payment from Molson Breweries to settle legal disputes with CBC, less related legal expenses.

* A $22.4-million reserve related to the recoverability of the company's investment in Jinro-Coors Brewing Company (JCBC) of South Korea. The JCBC reserve represents the full book value of CBC's investment in the Korean venture and was taken based on accounting requirements triggered by the recent recession in Korea and the resultant financial difficulties of Jinro Ltd.

* A $14.4-million charge related to CBC's brewery in Zaragoza, Spain, for severance costs and impairment of certain fixed assets. The impairment charge is based on expected future performance of our European operation at lower volume levels than originally anticipated.

Second quarter results last year included a special charge of $5.2 million pretax ($3.2 million, or $0.08 per share, after tax) related to the cost of legal proceedings with Molson Breweries and severance costs for restructuring CBC's engineering and construction operations.
